描述_EN: Bronze mirrors from mainland China have traditionally included dragons in their designs, but slim double-dragon designs such as the one on this mirror have been found since the Liao Dynasty. Both the Jin state in northeastern China and Koryo on the Korean peninsula had mirrors of the same type with exactly the same design, both made of white bronze with a relatively high tin content, and most likely mass-produced by the same workshop in a short period of time.
描述_ZN: 中国大陆的铜镜设计中历来都有龙，但像这面镜子上的瘦身双龙设计，从辽代开始就出现了。 中国东北的金国和朝鲜半岛的高丽都有设计完全相同的同类型镜子，它们都是用锡含量相对较高的白铜制造的，而且极有可能是在短时间内由同一工场大量生产的。
